# checkmk_contact_group (Resource)

Manages a CheckMK contact group configuration. Contact groups do not require activation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Basic contact group
resource "checkmk_contact_group" "admins" {
  name  = "admins"
  alias = "System Administrators"
}
```

```terraform
# Multiple contact groups for different teams
resource "checkmk_contact_group" "network_team" {
  name  = "network_team"
  alias = "Network Operations Team"
}

resource "checkmk_contact_group" "database_team" {
  name  = "database_team"
  alias = "Database Administrators"
}

resource "checkmk_contact_group" "security_team" {
  name  = "security_team"
  alias = "Security Operations Center"
}

resource "checkmk_contact_group" "oncall" {
  name  = "oncall"
  alias = "On-Call Engineers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Human-readable alias/title for the contact group.
- `name` (String) Unique identifier for the contact group. This serves as the contact group name.

### Optional

- `strict_resource_locking` (Boolean) Override provider-level strict_resource_locking for this resource. Controls ETag validation for resource operations. If not set, uses provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the contact group (same as name).
